LightningComponentBundle.description: Combobox with different configuration options that also supports multi select.

property.name: options
property.label: Options (JSON)
property.description: JSON array of options with label, value and optionally selected. Example: [{'label':'Option 1','value':'option1'}]

property.name: placeholder
property.label: Placeholder
property.description: Text that is displayed before an option is selected.

property.name: singleSelect
property.label: Single Select
property.description: Only allow the selection of a single value.

property.name: showPills
property.label: Show Pills
property.description: Show the selected options as pills.

property.name: enableSearch
property.label: Enable Search
property.description: Show a search input inside the dropdown.

property.name: disabled
property.label: Disabled
property.description: Users cannot interact with the combobox.

property.name: readOnly
property.label: Read Only
property.description: The combobox is read-only, and therefore also disabled.
